page_title: MON 0-3 LEV | B. Monchengladbach v Bayer Leverkusen 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gustavo Aldolfo Puerta Molano (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Victor Boniface.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ko Itakura will be replaced by Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
88' Bayer Leverkusen show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
85' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Jonas Omlin.
81' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Jonas Hofmann will be replaced by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
81' Today's match ends for Odilon Kossounou who will be replaced by Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen).
80' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Franck Honorat departs the field of play to be replaced by Yvandro Borges Sanches (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Here is a change. Tomas Cvancara is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
77' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared to safety by the defence.

77' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
77' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the bottom left corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
74' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Jonas Omlin is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

73' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. B. Monchengladbach are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
70' Substitution. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) has come on for Exequiel Palacios.
69' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Jeremie Frimpong.
69' The corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is hurriedly cleared.

69' What a great chance for Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. The ball goes behind for a corner. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' The referee awards a corner and Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take it.

68' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Nathan Ngoumou and he is replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
67' Substitution. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) in, Florian Neuhaus out.

67' Christian Dingert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
62' What a long-range shot by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
59' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
57' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
57' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

56' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
56' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jonas Omlin scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.

53' 0 - 3 Goal Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen)! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) was put through by Florian Wirtz and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 0:3.

52' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
52' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
50' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
49' Bayer Leverkusen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' 0 - 2 Goal! Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short pass from Jonas Hofmann in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the left post. 0:2.
45+5' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+4' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked for saying more than Christian Dingert was willing to tolerate.
45+3' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
45+3' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) tries to convince the referee to change his mind and receives a yellow card for dissent.
45+2' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
45+2' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
45+1' A precise low pass is received by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

42' Ambitious effort from Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
40' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
39' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Lukas Hradecky comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
36' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Jonas Omlin is equal to it and makes an easy save.
33' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
33' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
31' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
30' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck with a promising long-range shot from a rebound, but the ball sails painfully wide of the right post. What a great effort!
29' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
29' The ball is cleared after Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
28' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
26' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and it's Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
22' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
21' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
18' 0 - 1 GOAL! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) scores with a header from close range after Alejandro Grimaldo headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 0:1.

18' Bayer Leverkusen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
16' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
15' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
14' Christian Dingert interrupts the game. One of the players from Bayer Leverkusen won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. B. Monchengladbach are awarded the free kick.
13' A corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is thwarted by the well prepared Lukas Hradecky (Bayer Leverkusen).
12' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.
10' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.

9' What a chance! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner.
9' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
5' Christian Dingert blows his whistle. Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul after dangerous play.
3' Jonas Omlin displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
2' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! B. Monchengladbach will take the kick-off.
Christian Dingert was nominated as the referee for this game.
